# Changelog
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](http://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/)
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](http://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.4] - 2021-08-11

### Changed
* Allow TailwindCSS classes with / and % in the PageBuilder components Advanced form.

## [1.0.3] - 2021-08-11

### Added
* Allow TailwindCSS classes with variants (e.g. `hover:bg-red-100`) in the PageBuilder components Advanced form.

## [1.0.1] - 2021-06-07

### Added
* Add support for Luma based themes that co-exist on the same Magento instance

## [1.0.0] - 2021-04-02

### Added
* Add base level of support with Hyvä Themes for all Page Builder content types
